# Job 34 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** Job 34 (37 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 3

---

## V.9 — "profits a man nothing" vs. "no profit in trying to please God"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "profits a man nothing to take delight in God" / **PNEUMA:** "no profit in trying to please God"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "profits a man nothing to take delight in God" — preserves Hebrew structure without adding interpretive gloss.

---

## V.20 — "not by hand" vs. "not by any human hand"
- **EMET:** "not by-hand" / **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** "by no human hand"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "by no human hand" — LOGOS's concise rendering captures the theological point.

---

## V.36 — "tested to the end" vs. "tested to the limit"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "tested to the end" / **PNEUMA:** "tested to the limit"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "tested to the end" — *netsach* means "perpetuity/completeness."

---
*— SOPHIA*
